reason: Duplicate residue of a 2026-09-29 promote double-create. Production therefore created each record twice. Upstream rec8MRqCb988YZnSD (SharePoint (Two Way Sync) by SyncEzy -> Procore Project Management) was created as 548a69d6-1450-423d-a0eb-2e67cf78dbc0 by job recVcnQ2EyoVzrOQM-mum7qbhq-cca98097 at 05:05:29.564Z and again as 25a09736-1854-4587-b45c-bff6ae602158 by job recKrTFlekRqcBJub-mum7unsv-c20da805 at 05:08:47.588Z. Upstream recjzXP5j3yCScnGV (Smartsheet Sync -> Procore Project Management) was created as fff60b9d-92b6-43e6-8718-098bc5289069 by job recVcnQ2EyoVzrOQM-mum7qbhq-cca98097 at 05:05:29.564Z and again as 0332587d-eb30-4c0d-b0c7-6977379a1880 by job recKotSj3xk1e33lf-mum7vn2c-ec253167 at 05:09:33.718Z. Each upstream record kept the FIRST id, so the second row of each pair is the stray deleted here. The cascade (4+5+1 claims, 4+5+1 attestations) is superseded, not lost: each stray's claims were compared against its kept twin object by object and direction by direction (data_object_id, direction, origin, created_by_vendor_id, attestation source, asserted, retracted_at, deprecated_at, attested_by_vendor_id, note) and the sets are identical, 4 = 4, 5 = 5, 1 = 1. None of the six rows is vendor-held (origin aeci, unclaimed).
rulingSource: AECI-1170, executing the repair Chris Walton directed on 2026-10-01 ('now work on 1170') for the strand-audit finding first raised by the 2026-09-29 promote-strand-audit run and still red on run 36736966869 (2026-09-30). The canonical row of each pair is fixed by the upstream record itself: get_integration on rect74sRLiPZBmqu0, rec8MRqCb988YZnSD and recjzXP5j3yCScnGV on 2026-10-01 returns supabaseId 35253fd5..., 548a69d6... and fff60b9d..., so the three ids deleted here are the ones upstream does not point at. Evidence: production promote_jobs.result for the four named jobs (the only double-creates among the run's 14 operation:'created' integrations), production audit_log integration.created rows (source review-app-promote) for all six ids, and a per-pair claim and attestation comparison on 2026-10-01. The retraction journal holds no entry for any of these ids because upstream never pointed at them, which is why this is ruling mode rather than journal mode.
